name: Kosmos-213
about: Kosmos-213 (1968-030A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1968 Apr 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Apr 17), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
